candidates.name: Discoid Lupus Erythematosus

candidates.why: The patient's presentation of discoid lesions with scarring alopecia, along with the histopathological and immunofluorescence findings, is consistent with Discoid Lupus Erythematosus, despite the absence of systemic symptoms and negative antinuclear and anti-double-stranded DNA antibodies.
